why: Every entry writes its count as text beside the label again, the digit strip #1022 retired, now ahead of the row that already names the count. Assistive technology reads the count twice, and a `textContent` watcher sees digits change while the row it should be reading stays invisible to it -- the false comparison that nearly happened on #230. The count belongs in the row's one name, except beside the single unit of a narrow fallback.
